From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, Apr 22, 2027 at 15:05 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: POC prompt collection and eval plan

Hi Sarah / Tom, 

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the POC for AcmeCorp: 

1) Success criteria (as discussed)
   - Precision: >= 88% on extraction of SKU and pricing from support logs
   - Latency: 95th percentile generation < 200ms for short prompts (<= 200 tokens)
   - Business impact: routing accuracy increase of +12% for triage flows

2) Evaluation plan / dataset collection
   - You to share: representative prompt set (500-1,000), annotated labels where available, and 30 days of anonymized chat logs (we suggested a sample)
   - Redwood: will put together an eval harness (metrics, automated scoring, and qualitative spot checks), and provide a suggested prompt normalization script

3) Timeline (draft)
   - Apr 23: Acme shares prompt CSV + logs (anonymized)
   - Apr 26: Redwood completes initial ingest + QA and shares baseline eval report
   - May 3: Joint review to iterate on prompt set / success criteria

4) Owners
   - Acme: Sarah Lee (data & compliance), Tom Brooks (product)
   - Redwood: Marissa Cole (PM, POC lead), Connor O'Brien (AE), Dylan Brooks (SE)

5) Compliance notes
   - Please ensure logs are anonymized per the checklist in the doc we shared. If you need a short process for redaction, we can provide a script.

Attachments: I've included the POC success criteria template and a sample prompt CSV template for your convenience.

Next step: Sarah, can you confirm you can share the prompt set and a sample of logs by EOD tomorrow (Apr 23)? Once we get the files we'll confirm an ingest window.

Thanks,

Marissa
Marissa Cole
